basics.name: Bhimesh Chauhan
basics.label: Lead AI Platform Engineer
basics.summary: Based in Canada: permanent resident, authorized to work in Canada for any employer, no sponsorship needed. Lead AI platform engineer (10+ years of production software) operating at staff scope, with experience embedded with customer teams. Builds and runs production RAG and LLM systems end to end, from retrieval architecture to launch-day reliability, and leads teams of 4-5 engineers and designers. Roles of interest: forward deployed engineer, staff / principal AI platform engineer, lead / founding engineer.

work.name: Rare Days
work.summary: Architected and built a multi-tenant SaaS platform with a production RAG chatbot, owning the system from retrieval architecture through backend delivery and reliable releases.
highlights: Led Ask Kindred from SDK integration through production, serving approximately 200 daily active users across three customer companies with grounded retrieval, citations, conversation history and feedback.

Built RareDaysAI, the reusable multi-tenant RAG platform behind it, shipped as an npm SDK and CLI with config-as-code tenants, staging-then-approval production deploys, per-tenant capacity caps and per-client cost attribution. About 90% of the repository's commits are mine.
Runs it at under 5 seconds to first token and 99.99% availability for about $15 per client per month.

Evaluates retrieval and refusal behaviour against fixed question sets: a 55-query set for Ask Kindred (distress queries routed correctly 7/10 to 10/10, all out-of-scope queries refused with no grounding violations).
Led engineering for the Jefferson Fisher launch platform: about $700K USD in total sales in under 48 hours.
Designed the multi-tenant SaaS architecture, including backend infrastructure and role-aware access controls.
Delivered 10+ CI improvements that strengthened release quality and platform reliability.
Mentored a junior engineer and created reusable AI capabilities for other Rare Days projects.

Set the technical roadmap from MVP through production, balancing clinical workflow quality, security and reliability.
Worked with clinicians to validate outputs and guide the evolution of the AI system.
Led a team of 4-5 engineers and designers.
